title: UN Under-Secretary-General Gives Thumbs Up! Qwen AI Clip-On Earbuds Debut at Wuzhen Internet Conference
excerpt: On November 3, at the Wuzhen Internet Conference, Li Junhua, UN Under-Secretary-General, tried on the Qwen AI clip-on earbuds and praised their translation, mee
content_html:
On November 3, at the Wuzhen Internet Conference, Li Junhua, UN Under-Secretary-General, tried on the Qwen AI clip-on earbuds and praised their translation, meeting minutes features, and sound quality. He believes the product is very practical and suitable for his daily work scenarios that require communication in multiple languages.

During face-to-face communication, users can listen to translations through the earbuds; discussions in meetings can also be organized into structured minutes via AI note-taking for easy review after the meeting. After connecting to the Qwen App, users can also assign tasks such as research via voice and receive completion reminders, making the earbuds a portable assistant for daily office work.

The Qwen AI clip-on earbuds officially went on sale on October 13. Professionally tuned by Bose, they balance daily listening and AI-assisted office needs. During Double 11, the product also entered the top rankings of new headphone product lists and best-seller lists on multiple e-commerce platforms.
